prompt:
Create a faithful generated game asset for Crow, exact incarnation Resident Evil (1996). Use the attached verified references only. Preserve the precise head, anatomy, proportions, costume, equipment, material colours and asymmetric details. Do not mix games, phases or editions. Match the source appearance without added cartoon outlines, coloured halos or decoration. One subject only, no text, labels, scenery, floor, montage or frame. Clean transparent alpha. This remains a generated adaptation, not an original Capcom frame or a geometric 1:1 certificate. One complete full-body static combat idle base pose, facing right in a side/three-quarter fighting-game view. Keep every source-documented limb, foot, tail, wing, tentacle, horn and equipment inside the image with generous transparent padding. Preserve actual locomotion and support points; do not turn a quadruped or aquatic creature into a humanoid. Produce the entire body in this one image, not separate pieces. No motion blur, duplicate bodies or animation-frame grid. Only proceed after actually reviewing a complete source body reference.
The complete crow must have its open beak tip toward the RIGHT edge and tail extending LEFT, standing on both source clawed feet. Keep feather colours, folded wings, tail and toes from this exact source. Do not retain the left-facing source composition.
Composition requirement: at least ten percent transparent padding around EVERY anatomical and equipment endpoint. A clear RIGHT-facing side or three-quarter fighting-game base idle. One body only; no animation grid. Preserve source asymmetries rather than using a software mirror.
sourceObservation: Entire standing crow with open beak, folded wings, complete tail and two clawed feet is visible.
